$description: GanttChart (platform/charts/GanttChart.jsx; library wave 9, lane C): its component tokens. Bars and milestones take the chart's data-viz color (data-plx-dataviz); everything else is an existing role.

gantt-default-color.$description: Gantt chart: a milestone's color without data-plx-dataviz (the first categorical color).

gantt-task-width.$description: Gantt chart: the room before the plot for the task names (the frame's start margin).

gantt-label-room.$description: Gantt chart: the room after the plot for the share done after the last bar.

gantt-margin-block-start.$description: Gantt chart: the room above the plot for the today line's name.

gantt-task-font-family.$description: Gantt chart: the task names' typeface (UI text).

gantt-task-font-size.$description: Gantt chart: the task names' size.

gantt-link-color.$description: Gantt chart: a dependency arrow, in the subtle content color.

gantt-link-width.$description: Gantt chart: a dependency arrow's line width.

gantt-milestone-outline.$description: Gantt chart: the ring around a milestone in the surface color, so it stands off the grid and the arrows.

gantt-milestone-outline-width.$description: Gantt chart: the milestone's ring width.
